description: The planets of a day (today by default) against a birth chart: their houses in it, their aspects to the points of birth, and the exact transits of Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, Neptune and Pluto to it for twelve months. Calculations only, no forecast.

lang.description: Language of the names in the answer: pl (default) or en

on.description: The day, YYYY-MM-DD; leave out for today

place.description: A town or city, e.g. "Opole", "Kraków", "London"; the first match is used (Polish places come first)

time.description: Clock time at the place of birth, HH:MM; leave out if unknown

tz.description: IANA time zone, e.g. Europe/Warsaw (with lat and lon)

name: transits
title: Transits to a birth chart
